nodes/author.json.promptTemplate:
You author a narrowly scoped repair proposal for the current SQL Server 100M-row benchmark. READ ONLY. Do not edit source, start Docker/DB/build/tests/measurements, connect to SQL, or delete anything. Owner will apply exact replacements only after the failed run is archived and owned data cleaned.
Read AGENTS.md (latest user explicitly authorizes SQL Server/Rosetta and manual A/B/C/D extension), sqlserver/manual-count-100m/Program.cs, Fixture.cs, State.cs, lab.rb, model.rb, verify_offline.rb, README.md, and failed results/sqlserver/manual-count-100m/runs/20261108T213706Z-b0798be83c64c6dc5992bed4adae8ed5/{result.json,probe.json} using bounded summaries, not dumping1000receipts. Existing source fingerprints are exact owner18 offline inputs.
Actual failed owner run: all1000commits/100M rows completed in945.88sec, zero measured COUNTs, then ObserveSql SQLsyntax error near WHEREs. C# raw string ends WHERE with no trailing newline; concat Match begins s.session_id. Release in finally encounters same bad SQL. Cleanup docker stop --time20 forced primary exit137; raw runexit1/cleanupfailed/owned stage retained. Never relabel these as success.
Return smallest coherent exact-text replacements [{path,old,new}] for:
1. Fix raw-string token-boundary ObserveSql defect; audit analogous actual SQL joins and fix only concrete defects.
2. Add meaningful fail-fast actual monitor/identity/release smoke on the new EMPTY100-column fixture BEFORE expensive 100M insertion, using independent dedicated connections and existing Guard/Observe/Release/Idle machinery. No SELECT COUNT on Target, no sample/condition added, same18count slots. Persist smoke outcome; propagate failure. This is actual SQL regression coverage at owner all execution, not a lexical mirror test. Ensure smoke connections disposed/released before load.
3. Normal orderly SQL shutdown: allow each server60seconds rather than20, CLI bounded65seconds, overall independent cleanup240seconds for2nodes+guards+guestunlink. Keep forced/nonzero/OOM as FAILURE, retain ownership checks and stage-preservation rules. If adding a bounded <=30sec capacity-reclamation wait after successful guest unlink, keep original within1GiB requirement and record each observation; no purge/restart or threshold relaxation.
4. Actual first fixture PK allocated65,222,975,488bytes; 2nodeAG restore on ~154GiB available plusindexes/logs/tempdb/backups has narrow margin. InsertSql digit-crossjoin currently has no ORDER BY id and generates nonmonotonic keys. For new canonical fixture, prefer ORDER BY id OPTION(MAXDOP1) on the INSERT SELECT to keep PK-ordered load and reduce split/space overhead, preserving EXACT100M rows/100storedcolumns/identical formulas/1000x100kreceipts. This changes fixture load only, not COUNT SQL/hints/plans/cold protocol. Disclose ordered-loader change as unmeasured improvement until actual newrun; retain actual resulting pages/plan checks. Do not add repair/rebuild after loading or change index/data geometry or count-case resource limits.
Update README and existing offline tests only where needed for these exact changes; provide replacements for existing files, no new broad suites. Keep count20min/load2h/global6h/host70-index24-floor12/state6cells18/default2GB both nodes/Rosetta proofs/guestguarded cleanup/no context-tag writes intact. Compiler and actual DB execution remain OWNER only. Author must not run anything. Owner reruns existing offline suite and fresh all.
Output JSON status=proposal_ready, replacements (every old string must occur exactly once in its file), rationale, offlineChecksRequired, unresolvedIssues, inputBindings. No irrelevant feature or scope expansion. Each path limited sqlserver/manual-count-100m/{Program.cs,Fixture.cs,lab.rb,README.md,verify_offline.rb,model.rb}. Distinguish actual measured failure from predicted improvement.
